fan_coverage._definition: GT terminal heading = heading of the GT 5.0->6.0 s chord (gt_future_ext idx 49->59, ego frame at t0, convention verified against panel g); candidate terminal heading = fan_term_heading_nav_true (chord of the REFINED candidate's slots 6->7 = 5.0->6.0 s); error = wrap(candidate - GT).  hit@tau = at least one candidate in the subset has |error| <= tau.  subsets: ALL = every emitted candidate (r8 149 = 117 bank + 32 allocator extras; r7 117), BANK117 = first 117 columns, SURV = candidates the S2 reach mask keeps.

verdict.hypothesis_refinement_shrinks: REFUTED as stated (refinement adds +0.135 rotation in r8, +0.200 in r7)
verdict.measured_true_form: r8 refinement under-corrects the shared bank under-rotation: DIFF_EFFECT -0.0649 [-0.0923,-0.0398] (n=335 win/41 ep, 2-seed, EMA-15k vs refcv7); same-anchor subset -0.0286 [-0.0486,-0.0123] (n=127/37)
verdict.fan_coverage: saturated (hit@10.3deg 0.992 vs 1.000, n=262/32); not the problem
verdict.design_lever_hypothesis: near-horizon heading/curvature term on refined candidates weighted by GT |yaw|; bank tight-turn coverage is a PI-level second lever
